handoff: Reproduced: a stuck Bun.spawnSync can't be cut by bun test's per-test timeout once the file has already run a spawnSync (bun 1.3.13), so a stuck harness sh()/gitSync child stops the whole --parallel run. The stuck file on CI was upgrade-records.test.ts. Loop red 3/3; what made the git child stick is still open (ranked hypotheses). Seam: an integration-tier test that runs a fixture under bun test; fix by giving harness sh() a timeoutMs. ## Reproduce is posted on #215.
